detail: Full summary: config.deepMerge iterates Object.keys(TARGET), i.e. the defaults, so any config key absent from DEFAULT_CONFIG is silently dropped from a user's config.yml. Any future config option must be added to DEFAULT_CONFIG or it will never take effect.
